title: Evaluation of the Prevalence of Functional Digestive Disorders During Primary Sjögren Gougerot Syndrome
brief_summary: the investigators propose to carry out a prospective study consisting of a systematic research of digestive symptoms in patients with SGSp with the validated Global symptom score (GSS) questionnaire, which allowed to grades severity of 10 digestive symptoms (absent, mild, moderate, or severe), asthenia and fever.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with SGSp according to revised American-European criteria
* Patients 18 years of age or older
* Patients affiliated to the French social security care system.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients under measure of maintenance of justice.
* Patients unable to understand or to participate to the study.
* Child and major patients making the object of a measure of lawful protection.
* Patients deprived of freedom.
* Concomitant interventional clinical trial
